title: Signing of the Project with ARAMCO
summary: We are pleased to announce the official signing of a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) with Aramco, effective today and valid for the next three years. This marks a significant milestone in our research and innovation journey, establishing a framework for confidential scientific collaboration and the exploration of advanced research opportunities. The agreement strengthens our ability to engage in meaningful technical discussions, exchange knowledge, and pursue joint research initiatives that have the potential to generate impactful outcomes and contribute to advancements in the field. We look forward to building a productive and mutually beneficial research relationship over the coming years.

title: New in the lab: digital image correlation and 3D scanning
summary: The group has added a digital image correlation (DIC) setup for full-field strain measurement and a 3D scanner for dimensional checks of printed parts.
